# Toolblip
> Privacy-first developer tools for everyday tasks. 1,500+ free tools, no signup required, no surveillance. All tools run entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://toolblip.com/)

- [API Docs](https://toolblip.com/api-docs)
- [Status](https://toolblip.com/frontend-health)

## Tool Categories
- [Developer](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Developer) — JSON formatters, code generators, regex testers, hash generators
- [Image](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Image) — Resizers, converters, compressors, DPI changers, SVG tools
- [Text](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Text) — Diff checkers, case converters, slug generators, lorem ipsum
- [Color](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Color) — Palette generators, contrast checkers, HEX/RGB converters
- [SEO](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=SEO) — Meta tag generators, keyword density checkers, redirect checkers
- [Converter](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Converter) — JSON/CSV/XML/YAML/TOML converters, unit converters
- [Math](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Math) — Calculators, base converters, statistics tools
- [Network](https://toolblip.com/directory?category=Network) — HTTP status checkers, ping tools, whois lookups

## Key Information
- **Privacy:** All processing happens client-side. No files, text, or data ever leave your browser.
- **Pricing:** Free tier with unlimited basic tools. Pro tier ($19.99/mo) adds cloud storage, larger file processing, team seats, and API access.
- **Signup:** Optional. Most tools work without an account.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (frontend), Laravel (API), Railway (hosting), Cloudflare (CDN).
- **Contact:** info@toolblip.com

## Structured Data
All tool pages include:
- JSON-LD Schema.org `FAQPage` markup with question/answer pairs
- Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
- Twitter Card meta tags
